
============================================================
 CANDIDATE 1
============================================================

* 84V to 12V Buck, 150W
Vin in 0 84
M1 in gate sw 0 NMOS W=2 L=1
D1 0 sw DIODE
L1 sw out 100u
C1 out 0 220u
Rload out 0 0.96
Vgate gate 0 PULSE(0 12 0 1n 1n 1.16u 10u)
.model NMOS NMOS(Vto=1 Kp=2 Lambda=0)
.model DIODE D
.tran 1u 10m
.end
